sets.title: The limits of artificial intelligence
text: Artificial intelligence is advancing at {{1}} pace that few predicted even a decade ago. {{2}} impressive these systems have become, they remain far from infallible.

One difficulty lies {{3}} the fact that many algorithms are trained on data that reflect existing social biases. {{4}} developers are careful, these biases can be reproduced, and sometimes amplified, in the system's output.

{{5}} far, most regulatory efforts have focused on transparency rather than on restricting how such systems are used. Critics argue that transparency alone, {{6}} welcome, is not {{7}} to prevent harm.
It remains to be seen {{8}} governments will agree on shared standards before the technology outpaces the rules meant to govern it.

questions.explanation: 'Such a pace that' introduces a result clause describing how fast the pace is.
'However' + adjective at the start of a clause introduces a concession ('no matter how impressive').

commonWrong.although: 'Although' would need a full clause structure, not 'although impressive these systems...'.

questions.explanation: 'Lies in the fact that' is the standard preposition pattern after 'lies'.
'Unless' introduces the condition under which the biases will NOT be avoided.
'So far' is the fixed phrase meaning 'up to now'.
'While/although welcome' concedes that transparency is a good thing before qualifying that point.
'Enough' after 'not' and before 'to prevent' expresses insufficiency.
'Whether' introduces the indirect question after 'remains to be seen'.
